detail.longDescription: Google has rolled out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, replacing Gemini 3.8 Flash with immediate access rather than a staged release. It runs 2.5 times faster than Flash 3.8 in high mode, cuts fabricated claims more than fivefold and scores 54 on the Artificial Analysis index against Argon's 50. Pricing stays at 1.50 USD per million input tokens. https:// arstechnica.com/google/2026/11 /google-rolls-out-gemini-4-hydrogen-finally-replacing-3-8-flash/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
